description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:1287 clones base_dn for every NameRelativeToCRLIssuer DPN resolved. Called once per IDP DPN (rare; one per CRL) and once per CDP entry (up to a handful per cert) inside check_idp_dp_scope (lines 1366-1397).

For typical certs with 1-5 CDP entries this is a handful of DN clones, each maybe 100-500 bytes. Net cost: microseconds. Below threshold.

Documented here as 'considered and rejected as not worth optimizing today.' If profiling later shows this is hot, the fix is to push the relative-RDN appending into the comparison logic itself (compare 'cert_issuer_DN + cdp_rdn' against 'crl_issuer_DN + idp_rdn' without materializing the appended forms).
title: dpn_to_general_names clones the base DN per CDP/IDP resolution
